title: Insusceptible

inlines.v: INSUSCEPT'IBLE, adjective [in and susceptible.] 1. Not susceptible; not capable of being moved, affected or impressed; as a limb insusceptible of pain; a heart insusceptible of pity. 2. Not capable of receiving or admitting.
